statement: Wants an in-game way to earn aesthetic capes, even a long quest chain; currently cape vine and hat rack items only come from paid packs.
During the event you can use the green candle, then click a pack you lack, to snipe specific packs, but you still pay.
The weapons pack's 6x bigger damage on a golden vine now rapidly increases gains, which matters for emperor pushing.
Damage only really matters for emperor pushing, which is only relevant in statue week; statue week has three days left.
Needs to redo his prince setup because the update gave an extra bit of gains.
Caffeine's big day pack gives +10% key bind bonus multi, three golden vines, and 250% drop rate (about 2x drop rate).
Rates the pack high B or B plus if the three golden vines belong to the pack, decent for pay-to-win players.
If the golden vines are an account bonus rather than part of the pack, the pack is about C minus; he wouldn't buy it without the other capes.
Rift task: kill the regenerating boss with any four characters; hitting hard enough makes regeneration irrelevant. He just did level 62.
To get only shinies from collecting critters, go into cards and filter out your critters.
Rift task needing a kill on 11 characters forces breaking the pre-stacked divinity setup on a second account character, costing that edge.
Rift task is tied to a research mastery node whose reward is not in the patch notes and unknown to him.
Siegebreaker with stingers and the extender range talent can punch crooks from across the room, clearing the daily cattle crooks in about 5 seconds.
For the crook gem farm, filter all drops except gems, including statues like battle axe and world five opals, so gems aren't missed when you click fast.
Missed one character on the 11 character kill task; the game doesn't say which one so he had to recheck every character.
Rift level 65 task: get a pirate flag score of 75 on your Siegebreaker.
Picking the wrong character distribution (e.g. 10 archers or 10 warriors) can't be undone without deleting the account, and no archer means the pirate flag task is uncompletable.
Late in the game characters can't be reset via the gem shop; exalts, prismas and the new doublers can permanently break your account.
Skill mastery research nodes give minimum roll for observations (can't roll a 1), research EXP, research multiplier and max roll for observations.
His research EXP is 1.9; he plans to get happy chits at seven, has 11 points, and suggests saving 12 for future unknown content.
Research AFK gains node is weak since online play gives 100%, though it matters offline or after desync; still weaker than other nodes, 1% not worth a point.
The Halloween spinner name tag is extremely strong for research and world 7, yet only one pity exists and he has one jackpot after 200-300 pulls.
Bought the Forbidden Isle Menagerie shell; he is one shell away from the next menagerie unlock and may save for the next event.
Pipsqueak is the weakest event exclusive, not worth your time, though expensive things shouldn't create a huge gap between players.
With about a week left and 20 pulls a day, he won't max the tags, having burned months of farmed gems.
